text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: sudden p95/p99 regression for streaming endpoint /v1/stream (eu-central-1). p95=1.1s (SLO=500ms), p99=3.4s. Alert fired at 1756667890. Paging @oncall-rotation.
lina: I'm pulling up the latency heatmap + recent deploys. starting live triage.
roosevelt: any customer-facing errors? I see increased stream stalls but 500s are ~normal.
sam: quick check on deploys: infra-bot shows no model or canary rollouts in last 20m.
infra-bot: Deploy audit: no app deploys in last 30m. Scheduled job: kv-cache compaction ran at 1756667680 (15m ago).
metrics-bot: Snapshot: p95 5m=1.1s, p99 5m=3.4s, stream-chunk-timeouts spike. Top node: generator-pool-3.
lina: looking at per-session chunk wait times — lots of sessions show repeated 1.5-2.5s idle between token chunks.
roosevelt: grabbing pod list: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l role=generator -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,CPU:.spec.containers[*].resources.limits.cpu,AGE:.metadata.creationTimestamp`
roosevelt: generator-0 Ready, generator-1 Ready, generator-2 Ready, generator-3 OOMKilled (restarted 2m ago), generator-4 Ready.
sam: logs from generator-3: ```WARN kernel: grpc: client conn unexpected error: context deadline exceeded
INFO runtime: kv-cache eviction triggered for tenant=prod_team_x```
metrics-bot: inflight_streams per-pod: gen-0=8, gen-1=10, gen-2=52, gen-3=3, gen-4=6 -> gen-2 overloaded again.
lina: looks like compaction caused temporary KV cache pressure, plus gen-2 is taking disproportionate traffic (sticky routing?).
roosevelt: check router logs for affinity decisions: `grep gen-2 /var/log/router/affinity.log | tail -n 50`
roosevelt: found pattern where long-seq sessions are pinned to gen-2 due to session-hash bug introduced in routing v2.1.4.
sam: oh — routing change rolled out last week. maybe combo with KV compaction led to evictions and stalls.
infra-bot: Also noticed elevated gRPC churn: keepalive failures between router and gen-2 during compaction window.
lina: immediate mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable session-pinning (flip flag in router: `routerctl set session_pinning=false --region=eu-central-1`), 2) restart gen-2 to clear OOM/evicted cache, 3) reduce batch_max_tokens for streaming to 128, 4) enable fallback routing to even-spread mode if inflight_streams>30.
roosevelt: applying 1) now — `routerctl` change applied.
sam: restarting gen-2: `kubectl delete pod generator-2 -n inference` (force recreate)
metrics-bot: Post-change sample (45s): p95=520ms, p99=1.2s, inflight_streams distributed more evenly. chunk >1s rate down from 22% -> 6%.
lina: good. still seeing occasional 1.1s spikes — could be warmup after restart. will monitor for next 20m.
roosevelt: created ticket SRE-4681 to track root cause: suspected interaction between router v2.1.4 session hashing and KV cache compaction causing cache thrash and gRPC stalls. Action items: revert session hashing change or patch affinity logic, add guard to pause compaction under high traffic, increase cache hotset.
sam: also adding a regression alert: if p95 > 600ms for 3m in eu-central-1, page oncall with runbook link.
oncall-rotation: I'm oncall — handing monitoring to lina for the next 30m. escalate if p99 > 1.5s or error-rate >2%.
lina: handoff acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and traces, and coordinate with infra for any further restarts. 
metrics-bot: Incident mitigated at 1756668450 — follow-up ticket SRE-4681 created; mitigation steps: disabled session pinning, restarted affected pod, reduced streaming batch size, enabled fallback routing.
